en.caption_text: Warning and Caution Symbols. Must read to alert individuals to potential hazards or risks.
Read the user manual before operation.
Keep the product away from fire.
This symbol indicates that a lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery is inside the product and should be disposed of or recycled properly.

This symbol indicates that the product shall not be disposed of as household waste, and should be delivered to a designated collection facility for recycling. Proper disposal and recycling can help protect the environment. For more information about the disposal and recycling of this product, contact your local community, disposal service, or dealer.

source_concerns.issue: space before the colon 「ranges :」 and before the closing bracket 「45°C )」 in both temperature lines (op.l2a, op.l2b)
「including but not limited to overheats, emits unusual odors or smoking」 (mixed verb forms in the list)
「Ensure the device(s) are powered off before connecting it to the product」: plural subject with 「it」
comma splice 「depends on weather conditions, place your solar panel …」

「in accordance with all local codes ordinances」 (missing 「and」); the grounding text is printed twice (bullet op.l15 and the GROUNDING INSTRUCTIONS paragraph), heading 「GROUNDING INSTRUCTION-」 singular vs 「GROUNDING INSTRUCTIONS」
AC output 「18.3A Max, 2200W Rated」 per port and 「2200W Rated per port, 2200W in Total」: per-port and total ratings are equal although three outlets are listed
car input 「11V-16V⎓8A Max, Double to 8A Max」: the doubled value equals the single value; the spec table lines carry no PV/Car prefixes
「100V-120V~60 Hz」 with a space before Hz here, 「~60Hz」 in the specification table
「Jackery app」 and 「Jackery App」 both used
「Energy Saving mode」 lower-case 「mode」 next to 「Energy Saving Mode」 elsewhere
「Wi-Fi and Bluetooth」 vs 「Wi-Fi & Bluetooth」
「the HomePower 2000 Plus switches to stored power within 10 ms」: names a different product (Jackery HomePower 2000 Plus) in the Explorer 2000 manual
「provides up to 15 A (1800 W) … reduced to 12 A (1440 W)」 next to the AC bypass rating 「15A Max. (<3 hours when current exceeds 12A)」; unit spacing 「15 A」 vs 「15A」
missing space 「outlet.Do not」
capital 「Input」 in 「both DC8020 Input ports」
「of the Explorer 2000」 without 「Jackery」
double space 「ensure  0.66 ft (20 cm)」 (Web collapses whitespace)
label 「Dimension」 (singular)
double spaces 「2200W in Total,  4400W」 and 「15A Max.  (<3 hours」 (Web collapses whitespace); full stop after 「15A Max.」 only in this row
「LED light button」, 「LED Light button」 and 「LED Light Button」 (p7) for the same button
「Main Power Button」, 「main POWER button」, 「POWER button」 and 「power button」 for the same button

transcription_cross_check: Every line was drafted from an independent Tesseract 5 OCR pass (--psm 4) of the 300 dpi renders and then checked word by word and number by number against 300 dpi renders and 4x-8x clips (specifications, temperatures, port ratings and the safety pages on 4x/5x clips, punctuation on 8x). A scripted word and number bag comparison of every Web page against the OCR text left only OCR misreads (e.g. 1SA, TIV, 18.34, Tmonth, LiFePOs, 64) and copy printed inside artwork, each re-read on a clip. No reference edition text was copied; JHP-1000B-RC and JE-1500D US/en supplied structure only.

original_admission.caption_text: Batteries and accumulators must not be disposed of with household waste. As a consumer, you are legally required to dispose of all batteries and accumulators at designated collection points, regardless of whether they contain hazardous substances. Please return used batteries and accumulators to a local collection point, recycling center, or to the retailer where they were purchased. Proper disposal ensures environmentally responsible recycling and prevents potential harm to human health and the environment.
